mapper.select: SELECT project_id as projectId, client_id as clientId, title, description, budget, est_duration as estDuration, start_date as startDate, deadline_date as deadlineDate FROM projects WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND project_status = 'READY'

SELECT project_id as projectId, client_id as clientId, title, description, budget, est_duration as estDuration, start_date as startDate, deadline_date as deadlineDate FROM projects WHERE project_id = #{id}
